notes: §1985:VII.3.9.3 SR1: "Data-name-1 should be qualified when necessary, but cannot be subscripted, nor can data-name-1 be an item described with the USAGE IS INDEX clause." ResolveValueOfDataNames refuses (COBOL6849) a data-name-1 whose resolved usage is INDEX (an elementary index item, its own or inherited, §1985:VI.5.14.4 GR1) or whose OWN entry writes USAGE IS INDEX: a group at level 01 or 03 described with the clause (kb/Work PB5417, fixed: only the elementary usage was asked, so 01 G-IX USAGE INDEX named as data-name-1 compiled and ran FS=00 while its subordinate was refused). A group that merely contains an index item is not described with the clause and is admitted; the standard writes 'elementary' where it means it (§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR7). A table element is refused (kb/Work PB5299) and a subscript is the clause-operand capture's COBOL2024; qualification is the resolver's. Witnesses: 1985-SR-VII_3_9_3-1, pb5417-value-of-index-group (both the 01 and the 03 group refused).
